title: Make It Fun, Honcho
body_markdown:
Choose your frame color. Swap the plastics. Change the livery. Build something tasteful. Build something loud. Build something that will anger your neighbors for no particular reason.


Don’t hold back. Honcho certainly doesn’t.


Because Honcho is supposed to be fun. It’s small, playful, customizable, and not particularly interested in taking itself too seriously. Your build shouldn’t have to either.


Match everything perfectly. Or don’t.


Make it clean. Make it chaotic. Make it look like it belongs strapped to the back of an adventure rig headed somewhere with no cell service. Make it look like it should be parked outside your favorite corner bodega at midnight. Build the Honcho you want, not the one somebody else thinks you should have.


And if you hate what you made? Beautiful. You can save any build and go right back to making another.


The whole idea is to experiment, mess around, and see where you end up. You might start with one combination and wind up somewhere completely different five minutes later. That's part of the fun.


There are no wrong answers.


So stop overthinking it.


Make it fun, Honcho.


**Start Building Your S4 Honcho Today**
